newsitem.title: UK: NWE NAPHTHA SWAPS DOWN $5 ON CRUDE, GASOLINE.
newsitem.headline: NWE NAPHTHA SWAPS DOWN $5 ON CRUDE, GASOLINE.

text.p: NWE naphtha swaps fell back by around $5 Friday on the back of declines in crude futures and gasoline barge values.
September was by late afternoon placed by brokers in the $185-$185.50 range, compared with $190-$190.50 at Thursday's close, while August was $4.50-$5 lower on the day at $189-$190.
A London-based trader was seen bidding for 70 min paraffins naphtha at $196 but to no avail in a market composed of players with little urge or need to seek or offer volumes.
Early swap trades at $192.25 for August and $187 for September later followed by deals at $190 and $185.50 for August and September respectively.
